BiblicalUsage: Josibiah is named once, in 1 Chronicles 4:35. In 1 Chronicles 4:35 we read, "And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,".
TheologicalSignificance: Josibiah belonged to someone God knew, and I hold that every name in these lists did.
